name: Plastika Kritis S.A.
summary: Plastika Kritis S.A. manufactures and sells masterbatches and agricultural films in Greece. The company offers masterbatches in various option, including color, white, black, UV-stabilizer, additive, and filler masterbatches, as well as garden furniture compounds and PVC cables; and masterbatches for biodegradable polymers and biodegradable compounds used for the production of biodegradable plastic products, such as plastic shopping bags, garbage bags, and straws. It also manufactures polyethylene pipes for irrigation, water supply, gas and telecommunications applications; and recycled plastics, either as a raw material for use in proprietary products or available to other industries.
